shared_elements: human figures in strict profile facing the same direction
bearded male figures with elaborate curled/patterned hair and beards
figures in a row moving in one direction
justification: Both show low-relief processions of bearded male figures in strict profile, all facing the same way, with the same conventions for rendering stylised curled hair and beards, patterned garments and a raised upper arm/hand carrying or gesturing. The clearest difference is that B includes a large naturalistic camel led by a figure and is framed above and below by bands of rosettes, whereas A shows only closely packed human heads and torsos with tall headdresses and no animal or border motif.
